row.title: A retry that repeats its input never converges, and a test CI never runs never fails
row.body: Base Rates queue issues 3-27 stayed open for days because its loop re-fetched the same six Crossref hits and asked a temperature-0 model on every retry, so a topic that failed once failed identically forever; and github/verify.test.mjs was outside package.json test, so CI never exercised the loop. Rules: (1) a retry must change something it reads (window, phrasing, source, route) or it is a repeat, not a retry. (2) every *.test.mjs / *.test.js in a Node tenant is run by package.json test (TEST-COVERAGE-1, foundation/tenantstd.py uncovered_tests, run by tenantstd --check). Open Questions carried the same loop and the same gap.
